prune_dangling.description: also delete dangling nodes (last resort; prefer restoring the terminal); default false (report-only)

prune_incomplete.description: also delete incomplete (off-spine/degenerate) nodes; default false (report-only)

prune_stale.description: also delete stale nodes (source drifted; last resort — prefer re-syncing/rebuilding the source); default false (report-only)

prune_ungrounded.description: also delete ungrounded nodes (last resort; prefer re-grounding); default false (report-only)
